invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Map, either from new HashMap<>() or from context.mapToPair.
The result is empty either because partitionPaths is null or empty, or small file limit is non-positive.
At most one entry per partitionPath is inserted into the map.
If the parquet small file limit is non-positive, the result is always empty; otherwise it may be populated.
If partitionPaths is non-null/non-empty and small file limit is positive, result is non-empty.
